mode.form: 4 Favorite teams, 5 Live games (1 to 3 are older live modes; 0, My team before, is taken as 4)

fav1.form: league:id, or none or empty to clear the remote's slot 1

fav2.form: league:id, or none or empty to clear the remote's slot 2

fav3.form: league:id, or none or empty to clear the remote's slot 3

fav4.form: league:id, or none or empty to clear the remote's slot 4

tz.form: a timezone's display name, its IANA name, or its index in the panel's list

tzauto.form: 1 on, anything else off: follow the browser's timezone

panels.form: panels wide, 1 or 2; the panel restarts into the new layout

lockon.form: minutes before kickoff, clamped to 5 to 120

release.form: seconds after the final, clamped to 30 to 3600

collide.form: 1 alternate between two favorites playing at once, 0 stick with the higher one

favs.form: league:id,league:id,... in order, up to 16; empty clears the list; unknown teams and repeats drop out

live.form: league keys, comma separated, like nfl,mlb; empty puts Live games back on automatic

countdown.form: 1 shows the countdown to the next game between games, anything else off

cdname.form: the custom countdown's name, trimmed, up to 20 bytes cut on a whole character; control characters and bytes that aren't UTF-8 are dropped; empty clears it

cddate.form: the custom countdown's day, YYYY-MM-DD, 2020 to 2099; none or empty clears it

msg.form: the message card's own text; cleaned to what the panel can draw

msgurl.form: an http or https address of a text file, at most 160 bytes, or empty for none

msgevery.form: minutes between message cards, a whole number, clamped to 0 to 30

best.form: 1 pick the best game, anything else a random one

night.form: 1 runs the night schedule, anything else off

nightstart.form: HH:MM, 24-hour, like the page's time field

nightend.form: HH:MM, 24-hour, like the page's time field

nightscreen.form: 1 screen on at the night brightness, anything else screen off

nick.form: the panel's nickname, up to 32 bytes; emoji and bytes that aren't UTF-8 are dropped; empty clears it

lists.form: Name=league:id,league:id;Name=... up to 16 playlists of favorites, names up to 16 bytes without ; or =; empty clears them

list.form: the playlist Favorite teams plays, 1 to 16 in the lists order, 0 for every favorite; past the last playlist is refused

remote1.form: what button 1 on the remote plays: fav (favorite 1, the default), team:league:id (a favorite), list:name (a playlist), all (every favorite) or none (nothing); a team that isn't a favorite or a playlist that doesn't exist is refused

remote2.form: what button 2 on the remote plays: fav (favorite 2, the default), team:league:id (a favorite), list:name (a playlist), all (every favorite) or none (nothing); a team that isn't a favorite or a playlist that doesn't exist is refused

remote3.form: what button 3 on the remote plays: fav (favorite 3, the default), team:league:id (a favorite), list:name (a playlist), all (every favorite) or none (nothing); a team that isn't a favorite or a playlist that doesn't exist is refused

remote4.form: what button 4 on the remote plays: fav (favorite 4, the default), team:league:id (a favorite), list:name (a playlist), all (every favorite) or none (nothing); a team that isn't a favorite or a playlist that doesn't exist is refused

hook.form: the game events' webhook, an http address on the home network, at most 160 bytes, or empty for none; https is refused

pregame.form: minutes before the start for the reminder event, a whole number, clamped to 0 to 120; 0 sends none
